audit.method: Archived source PDFs under data/raw/SA/<symbol>/documents (SHA-256 re-computed and equal to data/raw/archive-index.json for all 26 archived files). Digital pages: text layer read and the printed figure located. Scanned pages (stc, Zain, Elm primary statements): pages rendered to PNG with PyMuPDF and read by eye, line by line, both columns. Findings are proven with page and line item; 'verified_correct' is claimed only where the printed page was read. Internal arithmetic (subtotals, reconciliations) used only as a secondary check, never as proof. Offline; no AWS, no Supabase, no data/raw edits.
tools_added_on_branch: docs/audits/saudi-independent/batch1-C-provenance-scan.json (machine scan of every fact vs its cited page)

status_vocabulary.verified_correct: printed page read; value, sign, period column, scale and unit match
status_vocabulary.defective: proven wrong or mislabelled against the printed page
status_vocabulary.unverified: source not available/archived or not readable here; nothing is claimed
status_vocabulary.verified_correct_with_caveat: value correct as printed but label/semantics need a note (no value change required)
status_vocabulary.pending (source status): document is not archived or not present locally, so the source cannot be re-read; resumable once archived

findings.metric: net_income, comprehensive_income, cost_of_revenue, operating_expenses, other_income, segment_revenue
findings.evidence: PDF p31/p32/p33 print five fiscal years side by side. The manifest publishes all five years only for revenue, gross profit, operating profit, profit before zakat, operating cash flow, cash end and the balance-sheet totals; for FY2021-FY2024 it omits: total operating expenses (136,690,984 ... 160,603,720), total comprehensive income (-39,002,488; -37,743,544; 42,079,695; 192,837,570), cost of services and other income (p32 FY2025 vs FY2024 only), investing and financing cash flows (e.g. FY2024 (54,629,222)/203,240,450), net change in cash (381,936,033 for FY2024 ...), and the segment revenue split for FY2021-FY2024 (Broadband 604,365,166 / 485,762,421 / 300,457,599 / 249,183,505; Voice and interconnection 411,753,569 / 144,577,369 / 78,096,166 / 32,916,164). net_income exists for FY2025 only (p35 zakat table: 220,932,941; FY2024 200,663,054 there equals the pre-zakat profit).
findings.fix: Add the missing multi-year rows from the same tables (p31-p33).

findings.evidence: p22: 'GO deployed its 5G network across 18 cities, covering over 30% of the population' - a lower bound stored as the exact ratio 0.30 (the company-profile manifest keeps '>30%'). The cited page 22 is correct for the sentence; the machine scan flags p33 only because '0.30' matches an unrelated figure.
findings.fix: Store as lower bound (qualifier 'greater_than') or drop from numeric facts.

findings.evidence: The issuer's row is titled 'Net Cash Used in Operating Activities' but the values are inflows in FY2022-FY2025 (+63,072,393; +5,245,776; +233,324,805; +215,804,057) and the only outflow is FY2021 (-16,173,557). Published signs equal the printed signs; arithmetic proof for FY2025: 215,804,057 - 59,836,437 - 29,297,425 = 126,670,195 = printed increase in cash. source_label keeps the confusing issuer wording.
findings.fix: No value change; add note that the issuer's label is misleading.

findings.evidence: Gap -1.40m (-0.63%): FY less (Q1+Q2+Q3) = 60.40 vs published Q4 59 ('reported as previous quarter' on the FY2026-Q1 announcement, rounded to millions). Revenue reconciles (1,461.79 vs 1,462.14). The announcements are not archived: cannot decide whether Q4 59 or the FY figure carries a reclassification.
findings.fix: Archive announcement 89304 and 85165 and compare the Q4/FY net profit; derive Q4 as FY minus 9M for consistency with the other Q4 values.

findings.evidence: GO's fiscal year ends 31 March. period_start/period_end are correct (e.g. FY2025 = 2024-04-01..2025-03-31) and fiscal_year = calendar year of the end date, applied consistently to annual, quarterly (FY2026 Q1 = Apr-Jun 2025) and balance-sheet instants. A consumer comparing 'FY2025' across companies compares Apr-24..Mar-25 for GO with Jan-Dec 2025 for the others.
findings.fix: Document the convention in the coverage layer.
